zh: On 32 fixed hard train-known sources, confirmed P rises from 5 to 12 and long P from 2/16 to 5/16. Matched-precision reference-token NLL on 64 sources falls from 0.74637 to 0.47464. Each audited source has two exposures in this phase; parent-history exposures were not reconstructed. Learning occurred, but these hard training meanings remain incompletely acquired, so a purely held-out-transfer explanation is insufficient. The separate repeated-tiny-set model reached 30/32 and 15/16 long: this establishes learnability of this panel, not guaranteed generalization from more repetitions. Language representation and reference quality remain possible factors. This hard panel is not the whole pool, a unique-cause identification or a 3B-capacity-ceiling test.
